sources.label: Morphe patches for mobile phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and more.
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops the app's analytics and install attribution services.
Disable AI
Removes the AI "Deal insights" verdict from deal pages.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
GmsCore support
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Hide device identifiers
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Hide promo code countdown
Removes the "New users only" label and the days-and-hours countdown from the promo codes on the home screen and the promo code page.
Hide prompts and pop-ups
Hides the prompts and pop-ups you choose in the patch options.
Hide rewards
Removes the reward points from the home screen and the Me screen, for people who only want the deals.
Hide sponsored cards
Removes the sponsored banner cards from the home feed.
Keep new-user promo codes
Keeps the "Best Promo Codes, New users only" card on the home screen instead of removing it seven days after you first open the app or create an account.
Show promo codes
Shows the whole promo code on deal pages instead of hiding it under the Copy code button.
Strip affiliate links
Opens each deal at the store's own page, without Koupon's affiliate tag.
